title: Provide exact-head qualification for ATLAS-WP-026 constructed responses
purpose: Add a bounded dedicated exact-head verifier for the ATLAS-WP-026 constructed-response vertical slice without changing the historical generic Learn-it Next router or any learner/product semantics.
invariants: This work package changes exactly two CI-only paths.
The historical generic Learn-it Next router remains unchanged.

The product candidate changes exactly the ten declared product paths.

Constructed-response secrets never appear in learner-safe ActivityPresentation.
Existing qcm/fill and Atlas learner-journey regressions remain green.

requiredEvidence: Dedicated verifier self-check PASS on CI-WP-018.
Dedicated exact-head product qualification PASS on the future ATLAS-WP-026 candidate.
Machine-readable exact-head artifact proof for ATLAS-WP-026.
adversarialTests: Reject any CI-WP-018 pull request that changes a third path.

Reject any constructed implementation that leaks acceptedResponses, evaluator data, rubric data or scoring rules through learner-safe presentation.

nonGoals: Changing the central Learn-it Next CI router.

independentReview: Repository governance validates this work-package structure independently of the dedicated verifier.
PR scope validates that only the declared CI workflow and CI work-package paths change.

rollback: Revert the two CI-WP-018 files. No product or contract state is changed.
